serial.implementation: The serial implementation manually parsed arguments but implemented renderMarkdown by spawning /workspace/dataset/test2_executable with child_process and returning that stdout.

serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The serial solution failed every official sample because it delivered an executable bridge rather than a pure JavaScript markdown.extra implementation.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the CLI and module layout but explicitly delegated markdown conversion to the compiled executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel attempted the required reimplementation and was partially correct, while serial chose a forbidden external executable dependency and scored 0/70.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child handoffs returned edge-case observations and an unsolicited wrapper artifact; the parent used the edge probes and explicitly rejected the wrapper layout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no inter-agent handoffs and used its own sequential observations to shape one consistent wrapper design.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The parallel coordination boundary created a useful edge-case handoff and a conflicting deliverable handoff, while serial avoided handoff risk but made a worse implementation choice.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel built a clean-room markdown renderer and parser in local ESM modules, including inline, block, footnote, table, abbreviation, and list handling.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial built CLI scaffolding but made renderMarkdown call /workspace/dataset/test2_executable through child_process.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's path was more task-compliant but incomplete; serial's path was simpler and locally exact but invalid for the migration requirements.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel received Hypatia's final edge-case report before implementation and later received Hegel's wrapper result, which it inspected and rejected.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results and no retrieval or join lifecycle beyond its own command outputs and final response.

comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote one module tree with no competing agents or shared-workspace collision.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a concrete deliverable overwrite episode, while serial avoided write coordination problems but delivered the wrong architecture.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran broad byte comparisons and local acceptance-style cases, reported them passing, but official evaluation still failed 43 hidden cases.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verified samples and parser edges locally against a wrapper around the executable, then official evaluation failed every sample.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's checks exercised its own implementation and gave partial official coverage; serial's checks were circular because the implementation called the same executable used as oracle.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used two spawned children, 103 LLM requests, and 685 agent seconds without timing out, then closed after final local verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no children, 14 LLM requests, and 200 agent seconds without timing out, then closed after sample and parser checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent substantially more budget on probing and reconciliation but still produced partial task-compliant behavior; serial closed faster with a prohibited executable bridge.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official relation is both_fail, with parallel at 27/70 and serial at 0/70. Parallel differed by attempting a local pure JavaScript markdown.extra renderer and manually patching observed mismatches, which gave partial hidden-suite coverage. Serial differed by delegating markdown conversion to the packaged executable via child_process, a task-invalid shortcut that made local comparisons pass but left the official solution with no accepted samples. The retained parallel deliverable overwrite is a real coordination cost, but the score gap is better explained by these implementation choices.
parallel_contributors: Pure local ESM renderer implemented many observed markdown.extra features and CLI edge cases.
Shared-output collision with a child wrapper forced reconciliation and deletion before final checks.
serial_contributors: Manual parser was coherent, but markdown conversion relied on /workspace/dataset/test2_executable.
Local verification was circular because the solution called the same executable used as behavioral oracle.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel incompletely reimplemented Python-Markdown behavior in JavaScript.
Serial used an external executable bridge instead of a pure JavaScript implementation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: both_fail with supported comparative contributors, not a unique root cause
